value: self-construal sets where the psychological boundary falls: interdependence draws the line between in-group and out-group, independence draws it between self and all others and so weakens the in-group/out-group split that produces biased empathy
quote: Our findings are consistent with a social-cognitive model of the link between self-construals and intergroup relationship ( Markus and Kitayama, 2010 ) that suggests that interdependent self-construals induce a strong boundary between in-group and out-group whereas independent self-construals define a strong boundary between the self and any others and lead to a weakened boundary between in-group and out-group.
